action_summary: Kept the v46 inference pipeline (new checkpoint snapshot, NER model, process_math) unchanged, and restored the rank-aware post-processing that v46 had removed and that accounted for the ~0.04 gap between v45 (0.4258) and v46 (0.3876): each predicted column is discretized with KBinsDiscretizer (quantile strategy, up to 20 bins, capped at the number of unique values) to create ties where the model is uncertain, columns that collapse to a single bin revert to the original continuous predictions, and each column is min-max scaled to [0,1] with a rank-based fallback so no column is constant. Predictions are clipped to [0,1] before writing submission.csv.
